# Third-party code

`packageSigner.js` and `xml-c14n.js` come from [tizen.js](https://github.com/reisxd/tizen.js) by Reis Can
(GPL-3.0-only), copied unchanged. tizen.js is in turn based on
[Samsung/webIDE-common-tizentv](https://github.com/Samsung/webIDE-common-tizentv) (Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE_APACHE2`).

The order of requests to the Samsung certificate service in `../certs.js` follows tizen.js as well.
